about: Round 1549. The F1 Higher or Lower pool (src/data/f1HLDrivers.ts) checked on 2026-10-22: every career win count through the 2026 Singapore Grand Prix, the 2026 race winners that move the counts, and the 2026 team of every driver still racing. scripts/simSportsFacts.mjs section 1 holds these nodes to the same source rules as sportsFactsVerified2026-09.json, section 11 holds the shipped file to them and every F1 Driver clue that counts wins to the same numbers, and simF1Champions section 4 holds the 1950 to 2025 part of every count to the f1_driver_standings record.

races2026.note: formula1.com lists 17 races with results for 2026, the Singapore Grand Prix (11 October) the latest; ESPN names the same 17 winners and calls round 16 the Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia, which formula1.com calls Bahrain. The United States, Mexico, Brazil, Las Vegas, Qatar and Abu Dhabi races had not been run.
